name: Bag of Chips
description: A crinkled bag of chips, mostly air. Salt is a luxury now.

name: Candy Bar
description: A chocolate bar gone pale with cold. Somebody will trade for it.

name: Soda Can
description: A warm can of soda with the sugar still in it.

name: Energy Drink
description: A bright can of something that promises wakefulness. It delivers.

name: Bottled Water
description: Two sealed bottles of clean water, still clear.

name: Instant Coffee
description: A jar of instant coffee. Hot water is the hard part.

name: Canned Soup
description: One dented can of soup with the label missing.

name: Canned Beans
description: A heavy can of beans. It keeps, and it fills a stomach.

name: Peanut Butter
description: A jar of peanut butter, half full and rich enough to matter.

name: Dog Food
description: A can of dog food. The label does not make it less edible.

name: Baby Formula
description: A sealed tin of formula. In the right hands, it is worth more than a gun.

name: Frozen Food
description: A frozen dinner, thawing and refreezing with the weather.

name: Cooking Oil
description: A jug of cooking oil. It fries food, lights a fire, and burns.

name: Coffee Beans
description: A bag of whole coffee beans, still smelling of the old world.

name: Hot Sauce
description: A bottle of hot sauce. It makes bland food and bad memories easier.

name: Dried Sausage
description: A hard, salted sausage wrapped in paper.

name: Powdered Milk
description: A tin of powdered milk. It needs water and patience.

name: Book
description: A hardback book, swollen with damp, still readable in the middle.

name: Family Photo
description: A photograph of people who are probably dead, smiling at something outside the frame.

name: Photo Album
description: A thick photo album, its pages stuck together with damp.

name: Wedding Ring
description: A plain gold ring, still on a string in a bedside drawer.

name: Pocket Watch
description: A pocket watch that stopped at a different hour than every clock in the house.

name: Sewing Kit
description: Needles, thread, and a thimble. Clothes and wounds both need mending.

name: Board Game
description: A boxed board game with most of the pieces. A night's entertainment.

name: Child's Toy
description: A plastic toy, bright and undamaged. It is hard to look at.

name: Winter Coat
description: A heavy winter coat, patched at the elbows and warm.

name: Work Boots
description: Steel-toed work boots in a size that might fit.

name: Sleeping Bag
description: A sleeping bag rated for a cold night, still zipped.

name: Camp Stove
description: A two-burner camp stove with a little fuel left in the bottle.

name: Propane Tank
description: A blue propane tank, still heavy. Heat, cooking, and a loud bang.

name: Jewelry Box
description: A small wooden box of rings, earrings, and one watch that still runs.

name: Home Keys
description: A key ring with a house key, a car key, and a tiny brass key that fits nothing here.

name: Cookbook
description: A cookbook with handwritten notes in the margins. Most recipes need things nobody has.

name: Cold Medicine
description: A box of cold medicine, half used. It does not cure anything, but it helps.

name: Antihistamines
description: A blister pack of allergy pills. Dust and mold are everywhere now.

name: Asthma Inhaler
description: An inhaler with a dose counter still in the green. To one survivor, it is a lifeline.

name: Epinephrine Pen
description: An auto-injector for an allergic reaction, or one hard minute of borrowed speed.

name: Syringes
description: A sealed pack of syringes, still sterile inside.

name: Vitamins
description: A bottle of multivitamins. Not medicine, but something to hold on to.

name: Sleeping Pills
description: A bottle of sleeping pills. Sleep is a risk and a mercy.

name: Medical Tape
description: A roll of surgical tape. It holds bandages, splints, and labels.

name: Prescription Pad
description: A doctor's prescription pad, half filled. In some places it is a kind of key.

name: Thermometer
description: A digital thermometer. The battery is low, but it works.

name: Reading Glasses
description: A pair of reading glasses, scratched but intact.

name: Nails
description: A coffee can of assorted nails, most of them straight.

name: Screwdriver
description: A flat-head screwdriver with an insulated handle.

name: Hand Saw
description: A hand saw with a rusted but serviceable blade.

name: Pry Bar
description: A short pry bar. It opens doors, crates, and arguments.

name: Wire Spool
description: A spool of copper wire, most of it still clean.

name: Car Battery
description: A car battery, heavy and maybe holding a charge.

name: Generator Parts
description: A starter motor, a fuel line, and a coil, wrapped in a rag.

name: Padlock
description: A brass padlock with the key taped to the shackle. Somebody meant to come back.

name: Chain
description: Six feet of heavy chain. It secures a gate, a door, or a person.

name: Circuit Board
description: A circuit board pulled from something that used to matter.

name: Servo Motor
description: A small servo motor, still turning freely by hand.

name: Neural Cable
description: A braided cable with a connector that fits nothing anyone still owns.

name: Coolant Canister
description: A sealed canister of coolant for implants and machines that run hot.

name: Implant Battery
description: A small, sealed battery for a cybernetic implant. It still holds a charge.

name: Surgical Tray
description: A wrapped surgical tray: scalpel, forceps, retractors, and a needle holder.

name: Sterile Drape
description: A sealed sterile drape. Clean work is rare enough to be worth carrying.

name: Lab Notes
description: A binder of lab notes in two hands, one of them increasingly unsteady.

name: Keycard
description: A plastic keycard with a photo worn blank and a magnetic strip still intact.

name: Communion Wine
description: A bottle of communion wine, dark and strong and not for drinking lightly.

name: Hymnal
description: A worn hymnal with a name written inside the cover.

name: Vestments
description: Folded vestments, still smelling of incense and old stone.

name: Incense
description: A bundle of incense sticks. The smoke covers other smells.

name: Chalk
description: A box of thick chalk, some pieces worn to stubs.

name: Ritual Knife
description: A black-handled knife with a dull edge and a careful pattern on the blade.

name: Offering Bowl
description: A shallow bowl with something dark dried in the bottom.

name: Tarot Deck
description: A tarot deck with three cards missing and one card that does not belong.

name: Absinthe
description: A bottle of absinthe, green as a bad thought.

name: Guest Ledger
description: A bar's guest book, with the same names appearing more than they should.

name: Collection Plate
description: A brass collection plate, empty except for a folded note.

name: Armory Key
description: A steel key on a labelled ring. Somewhere there is a door it opens.

name: Evidence Bag
description: A sealed evidence bag with a case number and a name.

name: Flare
description: A road flare. It burns bright, hot, and loud in every sense.

name: Teddy Bear
description: A teddy bear with one button eye missing.

name: Deck of Cards
description: A deck of cards, worn soft by handling. There are still four aces.

name: Cigarette Pack
description: A half-full pack of cigarettes, stale but dry.

name: Comic Book
description: A comic book with a bright cover and a story about people who win.

name: Lottery Ticket
description: An unscratched lottery ticket. The jackpot is a joke now, but someone will scratch it.

name: Camera
description: A digital camera with a half-charged battery and a full memory card.

name: Wedding Dress
description: A wedding dress in a clear bag. It survived the end of the world, somehow.

name: Surgical Mask
description: A box of surgical masks. Dust, blood, and bad air are easier to face with one.

name: Hand Sanitizer
description: A bottle of hand sanitizer. Clean hands save lives more often than clean wounds.

name: Fire Extinguisher
description: A small fire extinguisher with the gauge in the green.

name: Short Crowbar
description: A short crowbar that fits under a coat and opens most old locks.

name: Binoculars
description: A pair of binoculars, one lens cracked but usable.

name: Map of the City
description: A folded city map with three streets circled and one building crossed out.
